messages:
jules: Quick PSA: there is a jar of kombucha in the fridge labeled "DO NOT OPEN" and it's humming odd lullabies. anyone claim it? :grimacing:

arun: that is mine but i did not expect it to develop a theme song. it's the experimental batch.

peggy: please tell me you didn't name it. i'm not ready for the kombucha christening.

arun: i named it Sir Fizzesalot. short and regal.

jules: Sir Fizzesalot demands an audience. ritual options: 1) tiny crown 2) ceremonial straw 3) surrender a granola bar as tribute. react 1/2/3

peggy: 2 for the ceremonial straw. dignity matters.

arun: 1 and 2 both acceptable. i will accept the crown if it is tasteful.

kitchen-bot: Reminder: Per communal-food policy, label fermented items clearly and store in sealed containers. This is an automated message.

jules: note acknowledged. also proposing we add Sir Fizzesalot to the office lore wall (tiny drawing).

peggy: i will sketch a portrait. must capture the hum.

arun: deal. crown + straw + portrait. Sir Fizzesalot rises. :crown::tophat:
__notes: Single Slack thread string. Messages listed chronologically and prefixed with sender names per agents.md. No title field included.
